summary: Tests-only phase for issue #39. Committed: (1) the upstream solver parity corpus (viamin/color_matching#112, algorithm_version 1, byte-identical copy) as a test fixture, (2) WeightedSquaredErrorParityTests replaying all 12 scenarios through WeightedSquaredErrorScorer with earliest-wins selection and asserting exact agreement (score tables, exclusions, selection, error, tie evidence), and (3) PaletteAPIWireContractTests pinning the /api/v1 wire contract the swift-openapi-generator migration must preserve. Swift is NOT installed in this container (bin/lint skips build/tests by design), so swift test could not be executed here; the replay logic was independently verified against the committed corpus with an equivalent script: 12/12 scenarios reproduce scores, selections, errors, tie_broke and tied_indices exactly (including 5 tie and 2 no-selection scenarios).
